visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Real-life footage begins with a wide shot of a modern, bright kitchen featuring light wood cabinets and a stainless steel range hood. White text overlays appear centrally. (2) A woman with short brown hair, wearing a beige knitted vest over a white long-sleeve shirt, appears in a medium shot, smiling and gesturing with her hands towards the kitchen space. (3) The scene shifts to close-up shots of hands handling gray and tan cutting boards, followed by a sequence of objects like paper towel rolls and spice bottles being moved on the countertop. (4) A pair of hands wearing pink rubber gloves is shown spraying a white liquid onto a white wall surface and wiping it down thoroughly with a checkered cloth. (5) Close-up views focus on the induction cooktop and the underside of the range hood as the gloved hands wipe away grease and dirt. (6) The camera moves to the interior of a white microwave, showing a broken circular glass tray being removed and the interior surfaces being sprayed and cleaned. (7) A satisfying montage follows, showing various kitchen accessories, including spice grinders and oil bottles, being magnetically attached to the white wall backsplash. (8) The video concludes with a panning shot of the fully organized and cleaned kitchen, with final text overlays appearing on screen.

(3) During the cleaning segments, prominent SFX of spray bottles hissing and the rustling of cleaning cloths are audible over the music. (4) A distinct 'clink' sound of glass is heard as the microwave tray is handled. (5) A rhythmic sequence of mechanical 'clicks' occurs as kitchen items are snapped onto magnetic surfaces, perfectly synchronized with the BGM's beat. (6) The video ends with a warm closing statement from the narrator as the music fades out gracefully.
